d: Long, flowing jet black hair with a smooth texture is styled with long bangs and a thin, braided strand of bright cyan hair falling over the shoulder. The eyes are a vibrant cyan shade with a gentle, smiling expression, set on a youthful face with the appearance of a teenager. The build is slender, dressed in a white and silver outfit featuring a translucent white sleeve and a blue x-shaped strap across the chest. Signature details include a white flower hair ornament, a white headpiece with blue accents, and small blue teardrop earrings.
